name.ja: マクシミリアン・ロベスピエール

overview.en: Maximilien Robespierre was a leader of the French Revolution who became the dominant figure of the Committee of Public Safety during the Reign of Terror.

early_life.en: Born in Arras to a lawyer's family. Studied law in Paris on a scholarship and became an advocate for the poor.

impact.en: Robespierre's radical pursuit of revolutionary virtue and the Reign of Terror remain defining moments in the history of revolution and political extremism.

event.en: Elected to the Estates-General as a representative of the Third Estate
Became dominant member of the Committee of Public Safety
Arrested and executed by guillotine in the Thermidorian Reaction

title.en: Report on the Principles of Political Morality

description.en: Speech defining revolutionary virtue and justifying the Terror

text.en: The secret of freedom lies in educating people, whereas the secret of tyranny is in keeping them ignorant.
